comparison.objective: Solve a sliding-number puzzle to a specified order; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential planar tile sliding and precise seating versus fine tool engagement, torque, collar rotation, and physical impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Seven tiles within 3 mm and at most one within 10 mm, all seated, oriented, released, and robot retracted versus two safe damping cycles.
comparison.reason: Precision manipulation is shared only generically; the mechanisms and outcomes are unrelated.
